lf-release-actions.description: Consequential operations offered for one active release. Each direct lf-release-action names a package-declared one-shot request; the holder binds that request to the authored candidate and stable release so a crafted event cannot retarget it. The operation paints immediately as requested, remains locked while the host works, and finishes only when the host appends its receipt. A failed receipt reopens the same seat. This is an optional intervention surface, not automatically an Ask: use it when the operator may need a safe escape path without claiming the release currently needs their decision.
lf-release-actions.x-example: Request rollback to checkout-v1 Return all traffic to the verified stable release.

lf-release-action.description: One reader-facing intervention inside lf-release-actions. The required verb selects the holder's typed request; the authored prose names the operation and states its consequence. The holder owns the control, target binding, and request lifecycle.
